item.title: Recent Quant Links from Quantocracy as of 10/03/2026
item.content:encoded:
This is a summary of links recently featured on Quantocracy.

  • Buffett’s be greedy when others are fearful, tested [Quanter Lab]

    We rebuilt CNN's index from the seven market measures it combines and followed the advice to the letter.
  • Practical transaction cost checks for macro trading strategies [Macrosynergy]

    This article demonstrates practical transaction-cost checks using a Python class from the open-source Macrosynergy package.
